periods.label: Week of August 10, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Major QoL Updates, New Combat Mechanics & Account System Overhaul

features: Added a full account system allowing multiple characters and a shared stash across all accounts, including migration support for legacy heroes.
Introduced 'Swarm Mode' with dedicated server cooldowns and a countdown timer for high-intensity wave combat.
Enhanced character progression tracking by adding Soul points to the leaderboard display and death echo assignment.
Implemented a general auto-equip option to automatically equip items and spells into empty slots, enhancing gameplay fluidity.
Expanded Devlog capabilities with forms to track feature requests and allow AI workflow management for status updates.
bugfixes: Fixed issues ensuring owner aura effects remain properly synchronized and follow the unit's location during movement.
Corrected graphical glitches, specifically addressing lighting inconsistencies in swamp areas.
Improved the accessibility of crucial elements on mobile views by adjusting button placements and optimizing panel layouts for responsive display.
performance: The overall client experience was improved through dedicated fixes ensuring stable performance across various gameplay systems (e.g., wave cooldowns, aura syncing).
balance: Significant overhauls to character combat dynamics: Voodoo poison scaling is now level-based; multiple damage-over-time effects (Poison, Bleed, Burn) now bypass defensive mitigation. Combat projections were refined and block mechanics updated for improved resource flow.
The Thunder Aura was drastically amplified, receiving increased base damage, targeting range, and new ground impact visual effects.
ux: Mobile interface controls received a compacting pass to maintain usability without scaling down the main Heads-Up Display (HUD).
Visual feedback for battle engagements was enhanced with newly synthesized sound cues for spells, attacks, gold drops, and enemy deaths, alongside dynamic battle music loops.
graphics: The Thunder Aura's impact visuals were upgraded to include inward lightning arcs that fade over time, replacing previous simple ground-fill effects.

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
